name: Anteon (Ddosify)
description: eBPF-based Kubernetes monitoring and performance testing platform with no-code scenario builder and automatic service map generation.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present; Docker Hub: ddosify/ddosify (Verified Publisher); Self-hosted folder with deployment instructions

eval_notes: eBPF-based monitoring with built-in load testing. Automatic service map generation without code instrumentation. JSON scenario files for no-code test creation. Useful for monitoring agent behavior in Kubernetes-based telecom deployments.
